label: Unsolved Mystery

szenen.text: Nine hikers died in the Ural Mountains. *Nobody* fully knows why.
It happened in *February 1959.* They were experienced skiers.
Their tent was found torn open from the *inside.*
They fled into freezing cold, many *barely dressed.*
Some bodies had *severe injuries.* Others died of cold.
Theories ranged from secret tests to *aliens.* None proven.
In 2021, scientists modeled a rare *slab avalanche.*
What really happened? *Tell me* your theory.

caption: Nine experienced hikers died in 1959 after fleeing their tent. A 2021 study says an avalanche is plausible, but no one survived to tell. What's your theory? AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels. Archive images: Wikimedia Commons (public domain/CC0).

story_frage: Nine hikers died in 1959 and the case is still debated.
